translation.title: Amorolfine Hydrochloride Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for dermatophytosis (tinea) such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot, dyshidrotic tinea), tinea cruris (jock itch), tinea of the groin, tinea corporis (ringworm of the body, small-blister patch tinea) and tinea of the hands.
translation.usage: Apply an appropriate amount to the affected area once a day (in the evening). The treatment period varies depending on the type of fungus and the site affected, but it is usually used for at least 2 to 3 weeks.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, for infants and children, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Do not use it in the eyes or ears, or on mucous membranes. Adverse reactions may occur - systemic or local allergic reactions; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Rarely, skin irritation, erythema (red patches), itching, a burning feeling of the skin and contact dermatitis can occur. Store below 25°C and keep out of reach of children.
